name: filter-builder
title: FilterBuilder
summary: Query-DSL editor — operator/field/value chip rows. Each row is a (field, operator, value) triple. Composable AND/OR groups. Add-condition button + Save-as-view CTA.
description: Query-DSL editor with operator chip rows + composable AND/OR groups.
skillDescription: Use to build composable queries — Linear/Asana-style filter editor. Each row is { field, operator, value }. Stack rows under AND or OR groups. Pair with @lumen/saved-view to save the resulting query state.
useWhen: Lane filter — origin = LAX AND destination IN (SFO, OAK) AND status != cancelled.
Shipment filter — pickup-date BETWEEN x AND y AND lane = LAX→SFO.
anatomy: FilterRow × N — { field-select, operator-select, value-input/combobox, remove-button }
FilterGroup — wraps rows; AND/OR connector chip
api: `fields` — { value: string, label: string, type: 'text' | 'number' | 'date' | 'select', options?: ComboboxOption[] }[].
never: NEVER allow ambiguous operators (e.g. don't use 'is' for both equality and is-defined — split them).
NEVER let one row collapse the layout — use min-widths.
a11yRules: Each row is a labeled group with role=group + aria-label='Filter row N'.
Use semantic HTML — <fieldset> for the whole builder.
do: Provide type-appropriate operators (text: contains/equals; date: before/after/between).
